fields.finding: Ti/CFRP fittings were treated as tube materials in thermal CTE and mass while SiC capacities were retained.
fields.proposed_fix: Use SiC properties for all tubes, keep fittings separate, and rerun temperatures plus compatibility. Corrected fixed-temperature sensitivities are already tabulated.
